deck.name: Ritual Zoo Warlock
deck.verification: 30 cards read from the selected game deck
deck.remaining_basis: Selected list minus observed original cards outside deck, plus known generated cards still in deck; total reconciled with observed deck size
deck.count_warning: Not exact remaining deck: reconnects, generation, returns and transforms can change counts.
deck.plan: Build a board and timed Ritual waves; convert efficient trades into repeat damage. Against fast boards protect health and board first; against slow decks force answers, retain one refill and build a lethal clock. Do not spend an entire turn on value if current pressure wins.
deck.mulligan: Seek a playable turns 1-2 curve: Twilight Egg, Platysaur, Ritual of C'Thun, Twilight Timehopper. Keep Ritual of Summoning when early tempo is covered. Keep Floating Lessons only with a good minion target/curve. Entropic Continuity needs multiple bodies, not an empty board. Glacial Shard gains value against early attacks. Neophyte is better before a spell swing. Usually replace 4+ mana cards; evaluate Kazakus only with a strong early curve. This is a heuristic, not measured mulligan data.
sequencing: Mawman Cultist taxes ALL spells. Cast desired cheap spells before it unless the higher current Cost intentionally improves Floating Lessons and total mana still fits. Zakajz discounts minions and taxes your spells; calculate the whole turn with observed costs.

Floating Lessons gives stats equal to twice its CURRENT Cost, not printed cost. Check board target, hand minions and actual remaining mana. Spread pressure against single-target removal; avoid pushing every minion to 5+ Attack into Shadow Word: Ruin without a payoff.

Blasphemy hits all enemies including the hero. Check the highest CURRENT cost in hand, including ties. Spending a higher-cost card first may enable the second hit; never assume a 4-damage clear while holding a higher-cost card.
Catacombs gives a Temporary card: choose one useful before it expires. Xavius chooses from deck then adds a Dark Gift; evaluate the revealed actual result, not an assumed gift.

Platysaur's drawn card can be discarded on its death. Use the tracked card before sacrificing Platysaur when beneficial. Do not trade an egg just to hatch it if its next growth or resilience is worth more.

Continuity and Timehopper shuffle Shreds that deal 3 self-damage when drawn. Velocidrake needs a Shred and two free board slots for both bodies; Rush cannot hit the hero on the summon turn. Do not assume a Shred remains on incomplete history.
Rituals are delayed. Use observed countdown only; reserve board slots when Summoning is about to resolve. Kith'ix requires a completed Ritual, not merely one cast. Missing progress is unknown.

Kazakus takes three choices to build one trial. After paying for him, check the live costs against the base costs of 7 for immediate effects, 4 for next turn and 0 for four turns. If only delayed effects fit, take attacks you already intend before opening the choices. Match both effects to survival and board space. For C'Thun compare lethal, healing, taunts and refill.

candidates.name: N'Zoth Egg Priest
candidates.count_warning: Conditional unseen copies, NOT known hand contents. Includes unseen hand/deck; generated copies and tech variants can differ.
candidates.plan: Do not break Khelos eggs for no gain. Force removal while retaining one refill. Ruin kills 5+ Attack minions, Slime clears all and returns resummon spells, and Prepare may make Lifesteal buffs cheaper than printed. Compare pushing lethal versus denying a large heal; silence makes a single huge egg/buff investment fragile.
candidates.mulligan: Pressure on turns 1-3; seek bodies plus buffs rather than slow removal. Neophyte can protect a developed board.

candidates.name: Defensive Thief Priest
candidates.template_status: source list count is not 30; completeness or expansion is unverified
candidates.count_warning: Conditional unseen copies, NOT known hand contents. Includes unseen hand/deck; generated copies and tech variants can differ.
candidates.plan: A difficult matchup: pace threats into multiple waves. Mind Sweeper can clear 2-health bodies, Moonwell clears for 4 and heals, Ruin punishes 5+ Attack boards. Mix health/attack thresholds without sacrificing a real lethal clock. Silence and cheap conditional removal punish all-in buffs. Track observed copies; a copied card does not prove the original deck contains it.
candidates.mulligan: Favor resilient early pressure and a refill plan; Neophyte with early bodies can delay defensive spells. Do not keep late value alone.

class_plan.opening_model: Four uniform draws without mulligan; lists equally weighted within each equally weighted archetype.
class_plan.plan: Start Zoo on curve. Contest early pressure. Where cheap removal is common, spread pressure across bodies; where area damage is common, keep refill if another body adds little. Update after reveals; do not sacrifice lethal to hedge.

resource_calculations.scope: Current costs and mana are observed. Conditional rows assume ONLY the stated Mawman auras leave and no other effect changes. Spend-first rows are arithmetic, not proof of a legal sequence or a minion battlecry outcome. Re-read actual state after every action.

candidates.name: Ritual Zoo Warlock
candidates.count_warning: Conditional unseen copies, NOT known hand contents. Includes unseen hand/deck; generated copies and tech variants can differ.
candidates.plan: Contest board before racing: every surviving body threatens buffs. Use favorable trades and freeze to deny their buff targets. Track their Ritual wave and board space. Separate minion health above Blasphemy's 2/4 thresholds when feasible; do not assume their repeat condition is active without seeing their hand.
candidates.mulligan: Prioritize early minions, Timehopper and playable buffs; retain freeze with a curve. Avoid a slow value-only opener.

life_tap.compare: Compare holding life with drawing. Both margins assume the example trades work and remaining minions/weapon connect unblocked. Taunts can prevent that damage. Check hero power, visible effects, damage prevention, Shreds, waking minions and plausible reach. At a thin margin prefer a useful play/trade already available. For a risky Tap name a specific affordable immediate out; if holding already loses, drawing for a live out can be best.
